why: A commit, not a release, and that is a gap rather than a shortcut.

brand ADR 0003 makes the Assets release the distribution unit, and tokens/ IS one of the bundle CATEGORIES. But assets/wallpaper/ is deliberately excluded from that bundle, and the wallpaper set landed in bbcff9b on 2026-08-06, three days after the 2026.08 tag. There is no release containing everything red-dev needs.

tokens.json also moved after the tag: every hex is byte-identical, but the $extensions.reddb.contrastGuardrail blocks are new, and those are the reason for vendoring the source rather than a distillation of it.
Filed upstream: cut a release containing the wallpaper set, and add assets/wallpaper/ to CATEGORIES in scripts/bundle.mjs.
wallpaperNote: reddb-io/brand#107, merged. Re-vendored from that commit's assets/wallpaper/, unaltered. Five of the six are pixel-identical to the previous vendor (brand#98) and simply carry a better zlib pass; obsidian was palette-quantised and is the one that changed — see its encoding note. Total 1.3 MB to 1.1 MB. Still a commit rather than a release: assets/wallpaper/ remains excluded from the bundle CATEGORIES, filed as reddb-io/brand#102.

assets/wallpapers/obsidian.png.encoding: Palette, 145 colours — the only one of the six the brand quantised. It is the monochrome sheet, and flat art is where quantisation wins: 86 KB to 51 KB. Measured against the previous truecolor copy: 349,173 pixels differ (4.2%), RMSE 0.000512, peak error 7/255. The other five are halo gradients, which quantise LARGER, and are pixel-identical to what they replaced.
